## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-cards-records`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-cards-records -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `estate-board.json`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `estate-board.json`
- `regulation-feed.json`
- `corrections-feed.json`
- `evidence-reports.json`
- `opensource-stack.json`
- `orbital-ai-record.json`
- See the Data tab for all 12 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.
